div.span: New version replaces on macOS; on Linux and Windows only when the definition differs, and a current one only updates the record. Declined, cancelled, needs approval or elevation, or unavailable: back to the state before. A hold ends when the service answers, the version changes, or Repair or Install is pressed (they run past 3 attempts).

text.tspan: New version replaces on macOS; on Linux and Windows only when the definition differs, and a current one only updates the record. Declined, cancelled, needs approval or elevation, or unavailable: back to the state before. A hold ends when
the service answers, the version changes, or Repair or Install is pressed (they run past 3 attempts).
